chunks: Hearts are naturally disposed to love the one who does good to them, and to hate the one who does evil to them.

key_terms.بُغْضِ مَنْ أَسَاءَ إِلَيْهَا: hatred for the one who mistreats them
key_terms.جُبِلَتِ الْقُلُوبُ: Hearts have been created and naturally disposed in this way
key_terms.حُبِّ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ إِلَيْهَا: love for the one who shows goodness toward them

ai.seo_question: Why do people naturally love those who treat them well and dislike those who harm them?
ai.summary: This hadith states a basic truth about human nature: people are naturally drawn to those who treat them with goodness and repelled by those who wrong them. It highlights the moral and social power of ihsan in winning hearts and fostering sound relationships.
